title: Running Commentary on Torah 57 — Eimasai Ben David Ba
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 57 — אימתי בן דוד בא
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Opening ma'amar**: Sanhedrin 98a — **"Sha'alu talmidav es R' Yosei ben Kisma, eimasai Ben David ba? Amar lahen: li'ch'she'yipol ha'sha'ar ha'zeh v'yibaneh, v'yipol v'yibaneh, v'yipol — v'ein maspikin li'v'noso ad she'ben David ba."**

intermediate.en: **San 98a**: "when will Ben David come? When this sha'ar falls+builds, falls+builds, falls — no time to rebuild before Ben David comes."
intermediate.he: **סנ' צח**: "אימתי בן דוד? כשיפול השער ויבנה, יפול ויבנה, יפול — אין מספיקין לבנותו".

beginner.en: **Rashi**: **ha'sha'ar ha'zeh** = the gate of **Aram** (Aram in their time). **Ein maspikin li'v'noso** = the third time.

**"α. Every **dibbur** from HKBH's mouth creates a **malach** (Chagigah 14a). Each dibbur divides into **many nitzotzos** — **'k'patish y'fotzetz sela'** (Yirmiyahu 23:29; Shabbos 88b). From nitzotzos, **many malachim** are created. The dibbur-comprehensive (kollel) creates **a malach = sar + rosh** over the malachim of its nitzotzos (they are his **machaneh**). Each malach is **mumcheh al eizeh davar** (appointed over something)."**

intermediate.en: **α. Every HKBH dibbur creates a malach** (Chag 14a; Yir 23:29=many nitzotzos, Shab 88b); kollel=sar; each=mumcheh on something.
intermediate.he: **α. כל דיבור ה' בורא מלאך** (חג' יד; יר' כג, כט=נצוצות, שב' פח:); כולל=שר; כל אחד=ממונה על דבר.

scholarly.he: סעיף א. חג' יד; יר' כג, כט; שב' פח:.

beginner.en: **"β. To raise **emunah nefulah** = via bechina of **Yaakov** = via **neder** (Zohar Pinchas 255). Vowing a neder → restores emunas chachamim. When no emunas chachamim, chachamim are in hisalut=**pele** — **'hineni yosif l'hafli... v'avdah chochmas chachamav'** (Yeshayahu 29:14; Midrash Rabbah Eichah). **'Mi'ydei Avir Yaakov'** (Bereshis 49:24) = to **rectify the yadayim of the malach Avir**, one uses **neder=Yaakov**. From there **'ro'eh even Yisrael'** — via neder, emunah is rectified ("u'r'eh emunah," Tehillim 37:3). Rectified yadayim="lo sasur.""**

intermediate.en: **β. Raise emunah nefulah via neder=Yaakov** (Zohar Pin 255). "Mi'ydei Avir Yaakov... ro'eh even Yisrael" (Ber 49:24) → neder → emunah ("u'r'eh emunah," Teh 37:3). Emunah=lo sasur.
intermediate.he: **β. העלאת אמונה נפולה ע"י נדר=יעקב** (זוה"ק פינ' רנה). "מידי אביר יעקב... רועה אבן ישראל" (בר' מט, כד) → נדר → אמונה ("ורעה אמונה", תה' לז, ג).

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. זוה"ק פינ' רנה; בר' מט, כד; תה' לז, ג.

beginner.en: **"γ. When yadayim rectified via neder → **ohros ha'Avos spark**. Neder=Yaakov; yadayim=Avraham+Yitzchak=yamin+smol. **'Neged avosam asah pele'** (Tehillim 78:12) — via pele, avos' ohros spark. **Sofei teivos of Avraham-Yitzchak-Yaakov = בק"ם** = **notarikon 'b'shemen kodshi m'shach'tiv'** (Tehillim 89:21)."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Rectified yadayim → avos' ohros** (Teh 78:12 "neged avosam asah pele"). Sofei teivos Avraham-Yitzchak-Yaakov=בק"ם="b'shemen kodshi m'shach'tiv" (Teh 89:21).
intermediate.he: **γ. ידיים מתוקנות → אורות אבות** (תה' עח, יב "נגד אבותם פלא"). ס"ת אברהם-יצחק-יעקב=בק"ם="בשמן קודשי משחתיו" (תה' פט, כא).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. תה' עח, יב; פט, כא.

beginner.en: **"δ. Via these ohros → **oneg Shabbos**: **'az tis'anag al Hashem... v'hirkavticha al bamosei aretz, v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha'** (Yeshayahu 58:14). **Bamosei aretz**=Avraham+Yitzchak=yadayim; **nachalas Yaakov**=neder. Via avos+emunah=**oneg Shabbos**. Bechina of **Shin-bas**: **shin=avos** (Hakd Zohar 2b; 25), **bas=emunah**."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Ohros → oneg Shabbos** (Yesh 58:14 "hirkavticha al bamosei aretz, nachalas Yaakov") — avos+neder=oneg Shabbos. **Shin-bas**: shin=avos (Hakd Zohar 2b; 25); bas=emunah.
intermediate.he: **ד. אורות → עונג שבת** (יש' נח, יד "והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ, נחלת יעקב") — אבות+נדר=עונג שבת. **שין-בת**: שין=אבות; בת=אמונה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. יש' נח, יד; הקד' זוה"ק.

beginner.en: **"ε. Oneg Shabbos=**achilah b'kedushah**. Weekday achilah — sitra achra also partakes; Shabbos achilah — **no portion at all for sitra achra**. Hence we're commanded: **'ichluhu ha'yom, ki Shabbos ha'yom la'Hashem'** (Shemos 16:25). Shabbos-achilah = **pure kedushah/Elokus, no sigim**. Can accomplish via Shabbos-achilah **what ta'anis accomplishes** — felling enemies — **bi'z'chus oneg Shabbos**."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Oneg Shabbos=achilah b'kedushah** (Shem 16:25 "ichluhu ha'yom"). Equivalent of ta'anis for felling enemies.
intermediate.he: **ε. עונג שבת=אכילה בקדושה** (שמ' טז, כה "אכלוהו היום"). שקול לצום להפלת אויבים.

beginner.en: **"ζ. Via **tzom**, enemies fall. Via **ka'as from kaveid** (**'kaveid ko'es,'** Berachos 61b) is aroused the **mekatreg ha'gadol = Esav = Edom** (Bereshis 36) whose grip is in kaveid (Zohar Pinchas 234; Tikkun 21), **admoni** (full of blood). From him flow **m'katregim v'tzarim** below on the angry one. But **oneg Shabbos** breaks this without tzom: **'v'chol shul'tanei rogzin... kulhu arkin v'is'a'abru'** (Teiruma 135b); **'v'kula ahavah'** — **'ahavah b'sa'anugim'** (Shir 7:7); mo'ach+chochmah expand in his face (**'v'anpah nehirin b'nehiru ila'ah'**)."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Tzom→fells enemies** (ka'as from kaveid arouses Esav; Zohar Pin 234; Tik 21). Oneg Shabbos achieves same w/o tzom (Teiruma 135b "shul'tanei rogzin... arkin"; Shir 7:7 "ahavah b'sa'anugim").
intermediate.he: **ו. צום→מפיל אויבים** (כעס מכבד מעורר עשו; זוה"ק פינ' רלד; תיקון כא). עונג שבת משיג זאת ללא צום (תרומה קלה: "שולטני רוגזין... ערקין"; שה"ש ז, ז "אהבה בתענוגים").

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. זוה"ק פינ' רלד; תיקון כא; תרומה קלה:; שה"ש ז, ז.

beginner.en: **"When merits oneg Shabbos — no need for tzom. Accomplishes via eating what tzom does (subdues enemy). Shabbos-achilah=**kodesh**, **'v'chol zar lo yochal kodesh'** (Vayikra 22:10); kaveid subdued; all **ahavah**."**

intermediate.en: Oneg Shabbos > tzom: achilah subdues kaveid/enemies. Shabbos=kodesh (Vay 22:10).
intermediate.he: עונג שבת > צום: אכילה מכניעה כבד/אויבים. שבת=קודש (ויק' כב, י).

beginner.en: **"*Mo'ach+chochmah expand in his face** — **'v'anpah nehirin b'nehiru ila'ah.'**"**

**"η. To **subdue enemies** — tzom or Shabbos-achilah suffices. For **rov ha'shalom** (abundant shalom), must also **increase tzedakah**: **'marbeh tzedakah marbeh shalom'** (Avos 2:8). **'Agra d'sa'anisa tzidkasa'** (Berachos 6b); **'shemesh b'Shabbos tzedakah l'aniyim'** (Ta'anis 8b). **Shemesh=shalom** (Mekhilta Teitzei/Sifri; Yerushalmi Kesubos 4; Malachi 3:20 **'v'zarchah lachem yir'ei sh'mi shemesh tzedakah'**)."**

intermediate.en: **η. For rov shalom — add tzedakah** (Avos 2:8 "marbeh tzedakah marbeh shalom"; Ber 6b "agra d'sa'anisa tzidkasa"; Ta'an 8b "shemesh b'Shabbos tzedakah"; shemesh=shalom; Mal 3:20).
intermediate.he: **ז. לרוב שלום — צדקה** (אבות ב, ח "מרבה צדקה מרבה שלום"; בר' ו: "אגרא דתעניתא צדקתא"; תענ' ח: "שמש בשבת צדקה"; שמש=שלום; מל' ג, כ).

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. אבות ב, ח; בר' ו:; תענ' ח:; מל' ג, כ.

beginner.en: **"θ. Difference between **shalom of weekday-tzom and shalom of oneg Shabbos**: tzom-shalom has no **dibbur** — **'v'lo yachlu dabro l'shalom'** (Bereshis 37:4). But via oneg Shabbos-achilah, **dibbur is complete for shalom** — **'l'ma'an achai v'rei'ai adabrah na shalom'** (Tehillim 122:8); **'v'daber davar'** (Yeshayahu 58:13; stated about Shabbos). Peh is **completed in great ohr** at Shabbos eating. Hence Chazal: (see siman about Shabbos-conversations)."**

intermediate.en: **θ. Shalom tzom vs Shabbos-oneg**: tzom=no dibbur (Ber 37:4); Shabbos-oneg completes dibbur (Teh 122:8; Yesh 58:13 "v'daber davar").
intermediate.he: **ח. שלום צום מול עונג שבת**: צום=ללא דיבור (בר' לז, ד); עונג משלים דיבור (תה' קכב, ח; יש' נח, יג "ודבר דבר").

scholarly.he: סעיף ח. בר' לז, ד; תה' קכב, ח; יש' נח, יג.

beginner.en: **R"N editorial**: **"The gap below up to 'she'hevesi' — Rabbeinu skipped several words from his own handwriting when giving it to me to copy. He erased on purpose several words that were necessary to the inyan. I understood he had a complete kavanah in this."**

intermediate.en: R"N: Rabbeinu erased words on purpose before giving to copy — had a kavanah.
intermediate.he: ר"נ: הרבי מחק תיבות בכוונה — כוונה שלמה.

beginner.en: **"**Peirush ma'amar**: R' Yosei ben Kisma — 'eimasai Ben David ba' — when **this sha'ar falls** 3 times + no time to rebuild. **Sha'ar Aram = sha'ar d'sitra achra**. When it **falls after falls** via the bechinos he'd presented → Ben David comes, builds **sha'arei ha'kedushah**. I.e., when **no emunas chachamim + no one listens** — **'v'la'mochiach ba'sha'ar yikushun'** (Yeshayahu 29:21) — the **geulah via these broken-sha'arim**."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush ma'amar**: sha'ar Aram=**sha'ar d'sitra achra**; falls 3 times (via bechinos above) → Ben David builds sha'arei kedushah. When no emunas chachamim (Yesh 29:21 "la'mochiach ba'sha'ar yikushun") → geulah.
intermediate.he: **פירוש המאמר**: שער ארם=**שער דסט"א**; נופל ג"פ (דרך הבחינות) → בן דוד בונה שערי קדושה. כשאין אמונת חכמים (יש' כט, כא "למוכיח בשער יקושון") → גאולה.

beginner.en: **"Shayach to osios α-β: **'Ha'mevazeh talmid chacham ein refuah l'makaso'** (Shabbos 119b). All refu'os are **harkavos** (compounds): mixing measured herbs/potions. The **koach harkavah** = new power to heal. Likewise **Torah is refuah** (**'u'l'chol b'saro marpei,'** Mishlei 4:22). Only **chachmei ha'dor** know her, via the **13 middos she'ha'Torah nidreshes bahen**. Without chachmei ha'dor, cannot learn Torah."**

intermediate.en: Os α-β: **"Mevazeh t"ch — ein refuah"** (Shab 119b). Refuah=**harkavah** (compound). Torah=refuah (Mishlei 4:22); known only via **chachmei ha'dor + 13 middos**.
intermediate.he: אות א-ב: **"מבזה ת"ח — אין רפואה"** (שב' קיט:). רפואה=**הרכבה**. תורה=רפואה (מש' ד, כב); רק דרך **חכמי הדור + י"ג מידות**.

beginner.en: **"Torah is **aniyah bi'mkomah v'ashirah b'makom acher** (Chagigah 9b). Chachamim **lekatim u'm'arvim u'markivim** (gather+mix+compound) Torah, interpreting from place to place via 13 middos. They are **rof'ei ha'Torah**."**

intermediate.en: **Torah aniyah bi'mkomah...** (Chag 9b); chachamim le'katim+m'arvim+m'arkivim → rof'ei Torah.
intermediate.he: **תורה עניה במקומה...** (חג' ט:); חכמים מלקטים+מערבים+מרכיבים → רופאי תורה.
